pr_title: fix(AUT-76): admitir state_map.validated en aduana de manifiesto
pr_body:
## Summary
- Domain Authority acepta `tracker.state_map.validated` (laudo AUT-75 L-STATE).
- Anti-retroceso: `validated=4`, `in_review=5`, `done=6`.
- `project-config-contract` 1.5.0 declara `in_validation` y `validated`.
- Auditoría ciclo §3.4 alineada.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test -p execute-process --lib contract_accepts_state_map_validated_and_rejects_unknown_key`
- [x] `cargo test -p execute-process --lib state_rank_orders_cycle`
- [x] `cargo test -p execute-process --lib discard_when_issue_already_at_or_past_target`
- [x] `refine-item` AUT-76 ya no falla por `clave desconocida 'validated'`

Linear: AUT-76
